name: Character Of God
overview: Scripture reveals the character of God as perfect, unfailing, and full of steadfast love. He is eternal and all-wise, never growing weary or limited in understanding, and His ways are refined and trustworthy. God's love is demonstrated supremely in the giving of His only begotten Son for the salvation of the world, offering eternal life to all who believe. The fruit of the Spirit—love, joy, peace, patience, gentleness, goodness, and faith—reflects the nature of God, who is unchanging through all generations.
